cues.en: Let's see the same example as we just saw with searching using RAG, but in a slightly different manner.
cues.zh: 再看一次剛才使用 RAG 搜尋的範例，但這次換個做法。

cues.en: So let's just run it first, and then we will talk about it.
cues.zh: 先直接執行，再來解釋。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm going to say hello to it.
cues.zh: 這次先向它說 Hello，

cues.en: It just comes back and says hello.
cues.zh: 它就只回覆 Hello。

cues.en: It doesn't do a search, and that's because I put the search as a tool now,
cues.zh: 沒有進行搜尋，因為現在我把搜尋功能包成工具，

cues.en: so only when we search for something, it
cues.zh: 只有真正需要查詢資料時，

cues.en: will go and do the search on the fly and give us the answer back.
cues.zh: 才會即時執行搜尋，並回傳答案。

cues.en: So the way this is done is we have exactly the same as we had before.
cues.zh: 做法基本上和前面完全相同，

cues.en: That has not changed, but we have defined a search tool down here, and we have moved all the search we put in here before out into the search tool.
cues.zh: 只是把原本寫在這裡的搜尋程式碼，移到下面定義的搜尋工具裡。

cues.en: So now I have a search tool with an input, and just making the most similarity knowledge that we just return from the search tool instead of giving it into the messages.
cues.zh: 現在有一個接收輸入的 SearchTool，取得最相關知識後直接回傳，不再手動放進訊息。

cues.en: And then we have given this the tool of being able to search the knowledge, and we have instructed it to use that tool.
cues.zh: 然後把這個搜尋知識的工具交給代理程式，並指示它使用工具。

cues.en: This has benefits and drawbacks.
cues.zh: 這有優點，也有缺點。

cues.en: So one of the benefits is if we ask nothing about the knowledge base, we don't spend tokens answering back.
cues.zh: 優點是，如果問題和知識庫無關，就不會為額外搜尋內容花費 Token。

cues.en: So the pleasantries here for hello doesn't cost us extra.
cues.zh: 所以只是 Hello 之類的寒暄，不會增加額外費用。

cues.en: But if you have a very weak model, or if you ask in a slightly awkward
cues.zh: 但如果模型能力比較弱，或是使用者問法稍微模糊，

cues.en: way, like for example, what is the Wi -Fi?
cues.zh: 例如「Wi-Fi 是什麼？」。

cues.en: You can now see that it doesn't really understand that it needs to call the tool.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它現在不太理解需要呼叫工具。

cues.en: So the risk you're doing here is that you end up not calling the tool.
cues.zh: 這個做法的風險，就是可能該搜尋時卻沒有搜尋。

cues.en: And we can begin to prompt our way out of that, and we can say always use the search tool.
cues.zh: 可以嘗試用提示詞改善，要求它一律使用搜尋工具。

cues.en: But if we do that, what is the Wi-Fi?
cues.zh: 如此一來，再問「Wi-Fi 是什麼？」，

cues.en: It now knows that it needs to do that.
cues.zh: 它就知道應該搜尋了。

cues.en: But if we say hello, it also searches now because it's now been told that it
cues.zh: 不過再說 Hello，它也會搜尋，因為剛才告訴它，

cues.en: always needs to use the tool.
cues.zh: 每次都必須使用工具。

cues.en: So the best way here is to begin to go up in models in terms of them being more intelligent to follow these rules.
cues.zh: 比較好的做法，是升級到更聰明、比較能遵守規則的模型。

cues.en: So for example, a Chat GPT 4.1 is better at calling the tools and understanding when to call them and when to not.
cues.zh: 例如 GPT-4.1，比較擅長判斷何時應呼叫工具、何時不需要。

cues.en: So is the Wi-Fi?
cues.zh: 例如再問 Wi-Fi，

cues.en: Where the other one just asked what is Wi-Fi or just give an explanation of what is Wi-Fi in general.
cues.zh: 剛才那個模型只會問你指的是什麼，或解釋 Wi-Fi 的一般概念；

cues.en: This one is intelligent enough to know, hey, they're talking about what is the Wi-Fi at the office or what is the Wi -Fi in general I probably need to search.
cues.zh: 這個模型則夠聰明，知道可能是在問辦公室的 Wi-Fi，或其他與目前環境有關的資訊，因此應該先搜尋。

cues.en: So it's all a balancing.
cues.zh: 所以這始終是在取捨。

cues.en: If you put them up front like we did in the previous one, you are ensured that it will always search no matter what.
cues.zh: 像前一個範例把搜尋放在前面，就能確保每次一定都搜尋。

cues.en: And in real life scenarios, I do that at many cases where I know it's not too expensive to do the search.
cues.zh: 實務上，如果知道搜尋不太貴，我常常會採用這個做法。

cues.en: But if I know that it's expensive to do the search, I tend to put it out in the tool.
cues.zh: 但如果搜尋成本較高，我通常把它包成工具。

cues.en: Again, also if the real life scenario is that sometimes this chatbot can actually answer all
cues.zh: 另外，如果真實情境裡，這個聊天機器人有時候還要回答

cues.en: kinds of things with other questions like not the internal knowledge base, but also some support cases or customer information and so on, then
cues.zh: 知識庫以外的各種問題，例如客服案件、客戶資訊等等，

cues.en: it's better to have as a tool and let the AI choose, oh, this is an internal question about knowledge.
cues.zh: 這時做成工具比較好，讓 AI 判斷：「這是內部知識問題，

cues.en: Let me run it.
cues.zh: 我來搜尋一下。」

cues.en: Oh, it's not about that, then let's not do it as a tool.
cues.zh: 「這次和知識庫無關，就不用這個工具。」

cues.en: But again, we need to go up in models in order for it to be a bit more reliant.
cues.zh: 但同樣需要較好的模型，才能讓判斷更可靠。

cues.en: So that is actually everything there is about making this into a tool.
cues.zh: 把 RAG 做成工具，大致就是這樣。

cues.en: So nothing special in terms of tool calling, just like we saw in the section about that.
cues.zh: 工具呼叫本身沒有特別之處，和前面工具章節看到的一樣，

cues.en: The only difference is that now we're just using RAC inside the tool to get the data.
cues.zh: 差別只在於，現在工具內部使用 RAG 取得資料。

cues.en: So that's everything.
cues.zh: 以上就是全部內容。
